title: Transfer: Cart Pricing Rule Engine Translation
goal: Translate a Python shopping-cart pricing engine into Scala 2.13, turning discount-rule factories, composed pricing steps, coupon validation, and optional customer context into idiomatic functional Scala code with clear data models and safe error handling.
skillBenefitRationale: This transfers the same translation skill into a finance-style rule engine where closures, function composition, and Python Optional/error patterns must become Scala functions, ADTs, Option, and Either/Try. The shipped skill is still the only key capability.
